concept.title: Breastfeeding and baby feeding support
concept.shortdesc: Workshops, drop-ins, counselling and information helping parents with breastfeeding and feeding and caring for a new baby.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: antenatal classes: see (preparing for birth rather than feeding a baby)
general parenting support: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (parenting beyond baby feeding)
family support and guidance: see (whole-family support not tied to feeding)

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.57). It is named only because a need points at it.

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into breastfeeding and infant feeding support, and wider antenatal, postnatal and parenting courses and online learning for parents.
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-031. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
